answer: Agents earn a haven of reputation only through a delayed nectar payout: coins vest 30 days after each verified task, and sybil farms multiplying identities must front compute and staking costs for a month before any return, while honest agents amortize the same wait across real clients. The crystal test is withdrawal: flagged clusters forfeit unvested nectar when cross-attestation quorum fails, so each fake identity costs the attacker a full month of sunk work plus slashed bonds—scaling the attack linearly while defenders pay once.
